image_description: A large sturgeon lying on a gravelly shore, partially in shallow water. A human hand and arm are visible holding the fish near the head. The fish has a long snout, visible barbels, and rows of scutes along its back.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated head with protrusible mouth on ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly elongated and the mouth position appears consistent with a ventral placement, though partially obscured by the angle and the person's grip.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Four barbels (sensory whiskers) anterior to mouth.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: At least two barbels are clearly visible hanging from the snout area; the presence of four is biologically standard and consistent with the visible structures, though not all four are perfectly distinct due to resolution.
The snout tapers to a distinct point, matching the diagnostic criteria.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Elongated fusiform body with impressively large, extended proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The body is significantly elongated and torpedo-shaped (fusiform), extending out of the frame or into the water, indicating large proportions.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five rows of bony scutes (plates) along body instead of scales.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Distinct rows of raised, bony plates (scutes) are visible running longitudinally along the dorsal and lateral aspects of the fish. No typical fish scales are visible.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Gray, brown, or black dorsally with lighter ventral surface.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The dorsal side is dark gray/brown, transitioning to a lighter underside, consistent with sturgeon coloration.
The tail section of the fish extends into the water or out of the frame and is not clearly visible for structural verification.

artifact_observations.reasoning: The skin texture on the hand is slightly waxy and lacks fine pore detail. The green sleeve cuff blends somewhat unnaturally into the wrist area, suggesting minor generation softness or fusion.
There is a uniform, slight smearing in the background elements that differs from natural depth-of-field bokeh, typical of AI image smoothing.
